title: Pure Dream Mirror
summary: Dream Mirror cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Dream Mirror has two Field Spells, Dream Mirror of Joy (LIGHT) and Dream Mirror of Terror (DARK), and each monster comes in a LIGHT and a DARK version. With the matching Field out, each one tributes itself on either turn to summon its mirror twin from the Deck. Summoned by a Dream Mirror effect, each twin gets a bonus: the Sprite searches, the Black Knight destroys a card, and the Friend revives. Dream Mirror Hypnagogia places one Field on your side and the other on the opponent's, so both effects are live. The Fields swap themselves in the End Phase. The 2022 card leads. Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor searches Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple, then tributes a Dream Mirror to search a Field and summon another Dream Mirror. Oneiros, the Dream Mirror Erlking and Tormentor are the Fusion bosses.
main: Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor
Newest starter: searches Neiroy Disciple; tributes to fetch a Field and summon a Dream Mirror.
Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple
Summons itself; bounces a Spell/Trap or loots, depending on the Fields.
Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite
Searches a Dream Mirror card when summoned by one; swaps into Mara.
Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Mara
Summons another Dream Mirror from the hand; swaps into Sprite.
Morpheus, the Dream Mirror Black Knight
Destroys a card when summoned by a Dream Mirror; swaps into White Knight.
Morpheus, the Dream Mirror White Knight
Can't be destroyed the turn it is summoned; swaps into Black Knight.
Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Foe
Attacks directly when summoned by a Dream Mirror; swaps into Friend.
Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Friend
Revives a Dream Mirror; swaps into Foe.
Dream Mirror of Joy
LIGHT Field Spell: protects your top Dream Mirror; swaps to Terror in the End Phase.
Dream Mirror of Terror
DARK Field Spell: burns on their Special Summons; swaps to Joy in the End Phase.
Dream Mirror Phantasms
Searches a Dream Mirror monster; pumps or shrinks by Field.
Dream Mirror of Chaos
Quick-Play Fusion Summon of a Dream Mirror Fusion.
Dream Mirror Hypnagogia
Places one Field on each side of the field.
Dream Mirror Oneiromancy
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap or a Special Summon by Field.
Dream Mirror Fantasy
Recycles both Fields to banish a card.
Dream Mirror Recap
Shuffles tributed Dream Mirrors back; replaces a Field.
extra: Fusion boss: destroys a card when you tribute.
